main.description: Apply a branding bundle (see exportBundle). By default the bundle replaces the node's branding: keys it does not mention are removed. Every value is validated like updateBlob. Requires admin authorization.

broadcaster.description: DID of the broadcaster. Defaults to this node's.

merge.description: Keep keys the bundle does not mention instead of removing them.

dryRun.description: Report what would change without writing anything.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: The caller is not an admin.

errors.name: InvalidBundle
errors.description: The zip, its branding.yaml or one of its values is not acceptable; the message names the key.

detail.description: The new text value, or the image's type and size.
